summary.text: Stewart McAdoo is the Democratic candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent Art Washut (R) is also on the ballot.
He is a director of operations who served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2008 to 2011.

paragraphs.text: Stewart McAdoo said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has spent over a decade working in IT and cybersecurity operations, much of it with nonprofits and community organizations.

He said that before moving to Wyoming he was Director of Technical Operations at a firm that helps nonprofits use technology, and president and executive director of the Walterboro-Colleton Chamber of Commerce in South Carolina.
McAdoo said he now lives in Casper with his wife and two daughters and volunteers as a Visit Casper tourism ambassador.

McAdoo listed his campaign messages as opposing the transfer or sale of federal public lands, growing local jobs and supporting small businesses, and keeping rural hospitals open while supporting firefighters, EMS and law enforcement.
